resolved_findings.issue: the first antichiral auxiliary projector contracted a lower barD index with an upper field-strength index but retained the sign of the raised-derivative form
resolved_findings.resolution: fixed the projector to +1/2 barD^dot a tildeW_dot a vertical bar and added direct bridge-derived antichiral tests

resolved_findings.issue: the first W_A W_B formula wrote twice the A-to-B gaugino term, which is valid only after diagonal color identification or symmetric contraction
resolved_findings.resolution: displayed the A-to-B and B-to-A ordered terms separately and added exact distinct-color products in both signatures

resolved_findings.issue: f_AB^C denoted structure constants while f_AB(Phi) denoted the gauge-kinetic matrix
resolved_findings.resolution: renamed all structure constants c_AB^C and retained f_AB exclusively for the holomorphic kinetic matrix

resolved_findings.issue: the first off-Wess-Zumino statement assigned the chiral-frame barD derivative to the dual antichiral row
resolved_findings.resolution: defined the antichiral-frame row connection and its right-acting covariant derivative, while restricting flat-D coefficient projections to Wess-Zumino gauge

resolved_findings.issue: the first verifier assumed the field-strength component expansion instead of deriving it from the bridge
resolved_findings.resolution: added exact full-superderivative construction from V through both connections and field strengths to A, lambda, tilde lambda, D, nonabelian F, and the adjoint covariant gaugino derivative

resolved_findings.issue: the first general-action statement omitted an explicit exhaustive definition of the two-derivative superspace truncation and Lorentzian reality conditions
resolved_findings.resolution: defined the truncation, classified D and F densities, and fixed K, U, f, and xi reality

resolved_findings.issue: constant f_AB alone did not ensure gauge invariance or allow the positive Euclidean inverse
resolved_findings.resolution: required a symmetric invariant constant form with positive real part

resolved_findings.issue: the first Wick-action formula omitted the ordered time-contour measure Jacobian
resolved_findings.resolution: fixed d4x_L=-i d4x_E separately from the Euclidean epsilon orientation

resolved_findings.issue: the first positive-contour statement did not declare xi_A real
resolved_findings.resolution: fixed xi_A in R in the Lorentzian data and retained the Abelian-quotient constraint

resolved_findings.issue: an intermediate edit introduced a renderer-breaking form-feed in an unused Hodge-dual symbol
resolved_findings.resolution: removed the unused symbol and verified that the contract contains no control character

resolved_findings.issue: the first contour equation suppressed the matter index on shifted auxiliary fields
resolved_findings.resolution: wrote tildeG_I=-(G^I)^dagger and all contour identifications with explicit indices
